en: an animal like a rabbit with soft silver-grey fur. Chinchillas are often kept on farms for their fur.

zh: 中国的
en: from or connected with China

zh: 白菜；大白菜
en: a type of vegetable that is eaten cooked or in salads. There are two types of Chinese cabbage, one with long light-green leaves and thick white stems that is similar to lettuce and one with darker green leaves and thicker white stems. The first type is usually called ‘Chinese leaves’ in British English and the second type is called ‘pak choi’(BrE) or ‘bok choy’(NAmE).

zh: （弹子）跳棋
en: a game for two to six players who try to move the playing pieces from one corner to the opposite corner of the board, which is like a star in shape

zh: 灯笼
酸浆
en: a lamp that is inside a paper case, with a handle to carry it

zh: 口传失真（消息从一个人向另一个人传播时每次都发生一些变化）
en: the situation when information is passed from one person to another and gets slightly changed each time

zh: 中式英语
en: language which is a mixture of English and Chinese, especially a type of English that includes many Chinese words and/or follows Chinese grammar rules

zh: （尤指光线可进入的）裂口，缝隙，裂缝
一缕，一束，一线（从缝隙间射入的光）
（玻璃物品或硬币的）轻微碰撞声，叮当声
en: a narrow opening in something, especially one that lets light through
ex: a chink in the curtains
窗帘上的缝隙

zh: 下巴短小的（常被认为性格软弱）
en: having a very small chin (= part of the face below the mouth) (often thought of as a sign of a weak character)

zh: 中国式风格，中国艺术风格（见于西方艺术、家具、建筑）
en: the use of Chinese images, designs and techniques in Western art, furniture and architecture

zh: 奇努克风（冬末从落基山脉东侧吹下来的干燥暖风）
奇努克鲑，王鲑，大鳞大麻哈鱼，大鳞鲑鱼（产于北太平洋的食用鱼）
en: a warm, dry wind that blows down the east side of the Rocky Mountains at the end of winter

zh: 斜纹布裤
en: informal trousers made from strong cotton
ex: a pair of chinos
一条斜纹布裤

zh: 轧光印花棉布（用于制作窗帘、家具套等）
en: a type of shiny cotton cloth with a printed design, especially of flowers, used for making curtains, covering furniture, etc.

zh: 用轧光印花棉布覆盖（或装饰）的
便宜而俗气的；廉价的
吝啬的；小气的
en: covered in or decorated with chintz

zh: （与熟人的）闲谈，闲聊
en: a friendly, informal conversation with somebody that you know well

zh: 油炸土豆条；炸薯条
油炸土豆片；炸薯片
a small flat hard piece of food, often like a triangle in shape, made from maize
（木头、玻璃等的）缺口，缺损处
en: a long thin piece of potato fried in oil or fat
ex: He was eating a burger and chips.
他在吃汉堡和薯条。

zh: 芯片卡付款系统，智能卡付款系统（信用卡或借记卡上带有存储信息的微型芯片，付款时输入密码即可）
en: a system of paying for something with a credit card or debit card in which the card has information stored on it in the form of a microchip and you prove your identity by typing a number (your PIN) rather than by signing your name
ex: Chip and PIN is designed to combat credit card fraud.
智能卡系统是专为防止信用卡诈骗设计的。

zh: 不停地削（或凿）
en: to keep breaking small pieces off something
ex: He was chipping away at the stone.
他不停地凿那块石头。

zh: 芯片卡；智能卡
en: a plastic card on which information is stored in the form of a microchip
ex: Overall, chip cards are more secure than magnetic cards.
总体而言，芯片卡比磁卡更安全。

zh: 插话；插嘴；（对谈话或讨论）作补充
凑份子
en: to join in or interrupt a conversation; to add something to a conversation or discussion
ex: Pete and Anne chipped in with suggestions.
皮特和安妮插话提出了建议。

zh: （小块地）损坏，毁坏，剥落，被损坏，被毁坏
en: to damage something by breaking a small piece off it; to be damaged in this way
ex: He chipped off a piece of his tooth.
他锛缺了一点牙齿。

zh: （在英国以炸鱼薯条为主的）油炸食品外卖店
en: (in the UK) a shop that cooks and sells fish and chips and other fried food for people to take home and eat

zh: （高尔夫球）近穴击球，切削击球；（足球）撮球
en: an act of hitting or kicking a ball high in the air so that it lands within a short distance

zh: 刨花板；碎木胶合板
en: a type of board that is used for building, made of small pieces of wood that are pressed together and stuck with glue
ex: They had nailed chipboard across the broken window.
他们把碎木板钉在破了的窗户上。

zh: 花鼠，金花鼠，花栗鼠（栖于北美，属松鼠科）
en: a small North American animal of the squirrel family, with light and dark marks on its back

zh: 契普拉塔小香肠
en: a small thin sausage

zh: 墨西哥烟熏辣椒
en: a small chilli (= the fruit of a type of pepper plant, with a very hot taste) that has been dried and preserved by hanging it in smoke from wood fires

zh: thin pieces of dried smoked beef, usually served in a cream sauce
en: thin pieces of dried smoked beef, usually served in a cream sauce
ex: Mom's creamed chipped beef on toast was truly worth eating.
妈妈在烤面包上切成薄片的奶油牛肉真值得一吃。

zh: a style of 18th-century furniture, based on the designs of Thomas Chippendale. His book of designs, The Gentleman and Cabinet-Maker's Director (1754), spread the English rococo (= highly decorated) style to furniture makers outside Britain. A lot of the furniture made in America between 1755 and 1790 became known as Chippendale.
en: a style of 18th-century furniture, based on the designs of Thomas Chippendale. His book of designs, The Gentleman and Cabinet-Maker's Director (1754), spread the English rococo (= highly decorated) style to furniture makers outside Britain. A lot of the furniture made in America between 1755 and 1790 became known as Chippendale.
ex: a set of Chippendale chairs
一套奇彭代尔椅子
